### 🟡 Changes recommended The new tests are outside CI discovery and lack the required pytest dependency group, while formatting would fail Black and leaked SDK stubs make other tests import-order dependent.
3 open issues - [Wrap the overlong call to pass Black checks](https://github.com/OpenAEV-Platform/collectors/pull/710#discussion_r4674071729) · New - [Stubbed SDK leaks across tests and breaks import-order independence](https://github.com/OpenAEV-Platform/collectors/pull/710#discussion_r4674071769) · New - [CI skips tests because they are outside tests/ and lack a test group](https://github.com/OpenAEV-Platform/collectors/pull/710#discussion_r4674071808) · New
What changed in this PR This PR addresses #586 by keeping Tanium collection cycles running when API responses contain no data, allowing expired expectations to be marked not detected. **Changes:** - Return explicit `None` values for missing data and failed queries, with error-level logging. - Fall back to an empty alert list and preserve the alert GUID when intel is unavailable. - Add regression tests for missing responses and expectation expiry. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `tanium-threat-response/​test/​test_none_response.py` | Adds regression tests for missing alerts, intel, and response data. | | `tanium-threat-response/​test/​__init__.py` | Defines the test package. | | `tanium-threat-response/​tanium_threat_response/​openaev_tanium_threat_response.py` | Guards alert and intel handling against missing data. | | `tanium-threat-response/​tanium_threat_response/​api_handler.py` | Handles absent response data explicitly and improves error logging. |
Review effort: Balanced

review_comments.body: This call is 92 characters long and would be reformatted by Black, causing the required `black --check .` CI step (`.circleci/config.yml:539`) to fail. Please wrap the arguments over multiple lines.

These assignments permanently replace the installed SDK whenever `pyoaev.daemons` has not yet been imported; the check above does not establish that the SDK is unavailable. Since the stub has an empty `__path__`, subsequent imports such as `pyoaev.exceptions` or `pyoaev.signatures` fail, making tests run in the same process import-order dependent (CrowdStrike tests use both). Use the installed SDK, or isolate the stubbed collector imports in a subprocess so the replacement cannot leak into other tests.

CircleCI only discovers tests under `tests/` (`.circleci/config.yml:269–282`), so this new `test/` package causes Tanium's regression tests to be skipped entirely. Move the package to `tests/` and add a `test` dependency group containing pytest to Tanium's `pyproject.toml`: the runner uses `poetry install --with test` followed by `poetry run pytest`, but that group is currently absent.
